_comment: The bulk route. Shredding scrap tires into crumb rubber is a real industry and size reduction
is the Pulverizer's whole verb, so this needs no new machine.
It gets no steel belts: a mill does not sort, it reduces. The hand route keeps that advantage,
which is what gives it a reason to exist after the machine is built.
COUNT IS 1, and must be (owner, 2026-08-19): a GUI-less machine cannot take N > 1 inputs to
make an output, because a partial batch is invisible and unrecoverable.
